title: The inbox has no archive, dismiss, compose, sender filter or sort
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Inbox tab.
  • A notification addressed to you, from a note a second user wrote on a work order.
custom_steps:
1. On the Notifications page (click the bell icon at the top right; it opens on the Inbox tab), look for an Archived view, a Restore action, or a way to dismiss a notification from your own inbox while it stays on the record.
  2. Look for a compose action in the inbox.
  3. Look for a sender filter and any sort control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The inbox has no Archived view, no Restore action and no per-user dismiss - a recipient cannot remove a notification from their own inbox while leaving it on the record.
  • The inbox has no compose action.
  • The inbox has no sender filter and no sort control.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S1; design boards InboxAfter/Main; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1: “The inbox has no Archived view, no Restore action and no per-user dismiss. A recipient cannot remove a notification from their own inbox while leaving it on the record.”
  • S1-N5: “The inbox has no compose action.”
  • S1-N6: “The inbox has no sender filter and no sort control.”
